paragraphs: I am a technical lead who works across the stack: Java, J2EE and Spring Boot services, React frontends, and the AWS infrastructure they run on.
I also build systems projects in Go, Rust and Python in my own time. They include an identity-aware proxy, a SQL query engine and a Kubernetes operator.
